name: Raleigh Summer Youth Employment Program (RSYEP)
what_you_do: Work a paid summer job with the City of Raleigh for eight weeks. You build job skills, try out careers, and learn life skills.
grades: High school student as of May 31, 2027
who_can_apply: Ages 15 to 18 and a high school student as of May 31, 2027. You must live inside Raleigh city limits. You cannot be in summer school or school sports during the program, and you cannot miss more than 5 days. Only one person per household is accepted.
pay_detail: Paid work experience. The page does not state a pay rate.
deadline_text: 2027 application and interviews run January 25 to March 15, 2027. Onboarding with a parent or guardian is April 3, 2027. The program runs June 14 to August 6, 2027.
how_to_apply: Apply online from January 25 to March 15, 2027, then interview. Bring proof of a Raleigh address to your interview (a school ID without an address does not count). If you get an offer, you need a government ID and must pass a background check, a drug test, and fingerprinting.
notes: You and a parent or guardian must go to onboarding on April 3, 2027 and to the parent orientation (the page lists both May 16 and May 22, 2027, so ask which). A free Skill Up job readiness training is on January 23, 2027. Questions: Rebekah Dixon, rebekah.dixon@raleighnc.gov, 919-996-5722.
